name: 84601 · Provo, UT
findings: ZIP 84601 (Provo) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84601 (Provo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84601 (Provo) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
